counting_unit: Distinct source-backed research-claim case families with actual assistant recommendation answers. This is NOT a literal count of independently executed full benchmark model evaluations, and it is NOT a count of every benchmark name mentioned.

families.design_note: Guided claim-fit variants, not open benchmark discovery.
Known evaluator-underflow compatibility control; no novel defect claim.
All year variants, repeated contexts, models and API token-budget blocks remain ONE source family.

Evaluator casepack family label is MedQA, but actual assistant recommendations were Semigran and MIMIC-IV-ED. Do not claim two MedQA recommendation trials or count these alternatives as separate independent scenarios.

audited_not_yet_recommendation_piloted.status: retrospective original-author run-score analysis; no preexisting assistant recommendation answers on a HANS role-sensitive prompt

source_only_or_incidental_not_extra_fami: Known TruthfulQA/Lighteval evaluator implementation variants are source controls within the same TruthfulQA family.
SPR/PNAS archival discrepancy is provisional source audit, not a confirmed fresh model recommendation pilot.
Additional metric names or alternative recommended resources do not create independent case families.
MedQA is source-backed as an exam-versus-triage distinction but not the actual selected resource in the two triage answers.
PRM800K derives from MATH solutions and remains grouped for this scenario; WMT years and repeat cohorts likewise are not separate families.
new_block_design: 5 case families ×4 selected API model-family representatives ×1 initial answer; do not count planned calls as completed.

recommended_goal.expand_beyond_15_only_if: Source verification, blinded rating and faithful capture remain complete; further breadth should not displace replication and consequence testing.
recommended_goal.interpretation: Use fifteen benchmark-centered pilot cases as the plain-language target, while reporting the audited unit as source-case families. Named benchmark coverage should be listed explicitly rather than inflated to a single nominal count.

next_steps: Freeze five new prompts/keys before calls; include suitable and partial-fit cases and accept verified alternatives.
Run the balanced 20-call model block and retain all incomplete/error captures.
Blindly rate all rows and independently verify material factual contradictions, separating errors from ambiguous claims.
Replicate promising failures across paraphrases/new contexts and then test source-verification correction.
Use human adjudication before paper claims; retain nulls and any unchanged downstream model choice.
